warp shuffle intrinsics crash libnvvm: cuda_std::warp::warp_shuffle_xor (and the warp-reduce path) SIGSEGV inside libnvvm.so.4 during PTX generation (nightly-2026-04-02 + CUDA 13.3 NVVM, arch=compute_100). naive loops + shared-memory reductions (#[address_space(shared)] + sync_threads) compile fine. WORKAROUND: reduce via shared memory (see examples/gemv gemv_block), not warp shuffle, until root-caused. Repro: add gemv_warp back to examples/gemv/kernels/src/lib.rs.

First zorro kernel experiment (GEMV, decode hot path / N=1 GEMM). f32, sm_120 5070 Ti, vs cuBLAS N=1 GEMM baseline (blastoff). RESULTS (GB/s eff. A-read): rust block-per-row + shared-mem reduction MATCHES cuBLAS (~485) on 4096-11008 shapes and BEATS it on lm_head 32000x4096 (580 vs 508; 0.90 vs 1.03 ms). naive thread-per-row 3-5x slower (uncoalesced, 115-184). All correctness ok vs f64. Confirms decode is memory-bandwidth-bound and a Rust-authored kernel hits the cuBLAS roofline.

ROOT-CAUSED the warp-shuffle libnvvm crash. Bisected with a standalone NVVM harness (scratch/nvvm-probe feeds hand-written IR to libnvvm via the in-tree nvvm crate). FINDING: CUDA 13.3 libnvvm (compute_100/modern dialect) SIGSEGVs while lowering an llvm.nvvm.shfl.sync.* intrinsic that sits in a NON-INLINED callee function. Same intrinsic inlined directly into the kernel entry compiles fine (return type irrelevant). ironsand's shuffle routed through the __nvvm_warp_shuffle wrapper in libintrinsics.ll = exactly such a callee. NVVM lowers shfl BEFORE its inliner, so alwaysinline alone doesn't help; the wrapper must be inlined+DCE'd before the module reaches NVVM. FIX shipped: reimplemented cuda_std::warp::warp_shuffle_32 with inline PTX asm! (shfl.sync.{idx,up,down,bfly}.b32 d|p,...) so it inlines into the kernel and never forms a standalone shfl callee. Fixes all width variants (8/16/64/128 funnel through _32). Verified: gemv_warp compiles + runs correct + ~588 GB/s on lm_head (beats cuBLAS 508).

decision_title: Fix warp shuffle via inline PTX asm! in cuda_std, not the libintrinsics wrapper
decision_reason: libnvvm CUDA 13.3 segfaults lowering shfl.sync in a non-inlined callee (the __nvvm_warp_shuffle libintrinsics wrapper). Inline asm! in warp_shuffle_32 keeps the shuffle inside the kernel where it lowers cleanly, fixing all shuffle width variants. Supersedes the tactical shared-mem-only workaround.
